_notice: Known, verified content issues (see _planning/knowledge_assistant/13_CONTENT_ESCALATION_REPORT.md and the job-aid Review Guide). Conflicts are shown as 'Sources disagree' until the content owner decides. Nothing here decides which rule is correct.
_conflictPolicy: Owner decision (Jeremy, 2026-11-06): when job aids disagree, show the most recently revised one (by the printed Revised/Reviewed/Last Updated date) instead of 'Sources disagree'. A dated job aid counts as newer than an undated one. If none is dated, or two share the newest date, both are still shown side by side. Each role compares only the job aids in its own folders. To keep one conflict side by side anyway, add "keepSideBySide": true to its group below.
_quickAnswers: Quick answer box above the results (src/engine/answer.ts): facts = phone/fax numbers, emails, time frames, ages, counts; steps = the numbered steps for 'how do I' questions; sentences = the best-matching job-aid sentence. Set either to false (or delete quickAnswers) to turn it off, then rebuild.
